title: Electric Daisy Carnival EDC Orlando 2015 in 4K
description:
Orlando under the electric sky at the Electric Daisy Carnival 2015. Headliners included: Eric Prydz, Calvin Harris, DJ Snake, Tiesto, Bassnectar, Gorgon City, Carnage, Kaskade, and many more!

The amazing experience of the electric atmosphere brought to Orlando shot in 4K and brought to you by Eagle Eye Media. Visit us on Instagram for more @EagleEyeMedia_

Special thanks to Insomniac Events and everyone involved in creating this unforgettable experience. @InsomniacEvents
